verdicts.proof: The rule itself is shared. canProceedNow() at core/booking_form_widget.dart:536-556 needs dates, no missing sizes, err==null, profileErr==null, the consents and datesKnown. v2 gets canProceedNow() && !rangeBusy (:582). The dock CTA is the only v2 path to /payment for a new booking: booking_dock_v2.dart:138-145 (onTap: canProceed ? onProceed : null, enabled: canProceed; mg_cta.dart:90,212-217 drop the tap when inactive), and onProceed is set at booking_form_widget.dart:603. A grep of lib/ finds no other push of /payment for a NEW booking (shell_actions.dart:25, booking_restore.dart:103, reservation_edit_screen.dart:1127 and reservation_swap_section.dart:302 resume or edit existing bookings). The deep link /payment (router.dart:418) needs login (:188) and works the same in both looks. The payment insert (_createDraftBooking, payment_screen.dart:562-608) is shared because v2 calls onPay: _doPayment (:1522-1544). One input differs, though. In v2, startBookingFromSelection (features/booking/booking_entry.dart:66-90) calls carryBookingDraft (features/booking/v2/booking_carry_v2.dart:35-45). For the SAME bike it returns prev.copyWith(...) without resetting consentVop, consentGdpr or consentKids, so the consents stay ticked when the customer comes back to the form, even with new dates. The old look always builds a fresh draft (booking_entry.dart:62-66; booking_models.dart:84-86 default false). The consents part of this CTA lock is therefore pre-satisfied in v2; the same finding is tracked as G-159/G-231. All other parts of the lock hold and are explained more clearly: the first blocker appears in the dock (booking_form_view_v2.dart:162-176) and the reasons appear as banners with headings (booking_warning_v2.dart).
verdicts.fix_idea: In carryBookingDraft (same-bike branch) also pass consentVop:false, consentGdpr:false, consentKids:false, or at least reset them when the dates change, so the CTA again waits for fresh consents as in the old look.

verdicts.proof: Both looks use the same check: licenseValidationProvider (booking_provider.dart:212-233) feeds BookingValidator.checkLicense and then bookingValidationErrorProvider (:299-304). The old look shows it as a red box at booking_form_widget.dart:736-769, and the CTA is null while err!=null (:551, :888-891). v2 gets the same err (booking_form_widget.dart:571), and canProceed includes it (:582). The only v2 path to /payment is the dock CTA (booking_dock_v2.dart:141-142). v2 shows a red banner with the heading 'Takhle rezervaci dokončit nejde' and the same text (booking_warning_v2.dart:53-65). It adds the fixes 'Vybrat jinou motorku' and 'Doplnit v profilu' (booking_form_view_v2.dart:150-153, errKind from booking_sync_v2.dart:78-85) and the dock line 'Zkontroluj termín a údaje výše' (:171). The server does not check the licence group at insert, and neither look re-checks it on /payment; this does not depend on the look.

Both looks compute profileCompletenessValidationProvider (booking_provider.dart:312-338) once in build (booking_form_widget.dart:418). The old look shows the amber box with 'Doplnit v profilu' (/profile) at :772-832 and locks the CTA at :552. v2 gets profileErr (:572) and canProceed (:582), shows an amber banner with the heading 'Chybí údaje pro smlouvu', the same text and the button completeProfileBtn going to /profile (booking_warning_v2.dart:66-75; onCompleteProfile at booking_form_widget.dart:605), and puts 'Chybí údaje v profilu' in the dock (booking_form_view_v2.dart:172). The payment insert re-checks it in both looks (payment_screen.dart:603-608), on the shared _doPayment path.

The expiry check is in the same provider (booking_provider.dart:340-350: license_expiry before draft.endDate, or before today, returns validationLicenseExpired). It reaches v2 as profileErr (booking_form_widget.dart:572), feeds the same canProceed (:582) and the same amber banner with 'Doplnit v profilu' (booking_warning_v2.dart:66-75), and the dock blocker (booking_form_view_v2.dart:172). Payment re-checks it through the same provider (payment_screen.dart:603).

The trailer clean-up runs in build() at booking_form_widget.dart:428-438, before the MgV2.on branch at :560, so it runs in both looks. The trailer tile is hidden at a self-service branch in both looks: v2 at booking_form_extras_section.dart:245 and the old look at :361, both with !isKids && !selfService. The shared insert also drops it (payment_screen.dart:586-591, :753), and the trigger trg_check_trailer_overlap refuses it. Silent in both looks, as before.
verdicts.fix_idea: None needed: the old look is silent too.

verdicts.proof: The passenger-extras clean-up runs at booking_form_widget.dart:485-497, before the v2 branch at :560. The tile filter extraTiles at booking_form_extras_section.dart:66-70 is computed before either look's tree is built (v2 flag at :52), so neither look offers the passenger tiles for a kids bike. Silent in both looks.
verdicts.fix_idea: None needed: the old look is silent too.

verdicts.proof: The off-list size reset (offList, booking_form_widget.dart:501-514) runs before the v2 branch at :560. missingSizes, computed from the cleaned draft, is passed to v2 (:581) and feeds both canProceed and the v2 sizes banner (booking_warning_v2.dart:47-52). The v2 size chips use the same gearSizesFor(type, kids, selfService) (booking_form_extras_section.dart:223-241). The reset is silent in both looks; v2 then shows the 'Doplň velikosti výbavy' banner.
verdicts.fix_idea: None needed: the old look is silent too.

verdicts.proof: The new entry points are the home funnel CTA (features/home/v2/home_funnel_v2.dart:216) and the calculator book() (features/catalog/v2/calc/calc_body_v2.dart:148-149). The calculator offers the sticky button only when blocked==null, that is, not while loading, not after a failed load and not when the range is busy (:139-149). Both only call startBookingFromSelection (features/booking/booking_entry.dart:27-91), which sets bookingMotoProvider and the draft and pushes /booking (:90). Neither reaches /payment. The form then recomputes err, profileErr, missingSizes, datesKnown and rangeBusy (booking_form_widget.dart:411-582). One caveat: these entries use carryBookingDraft, which carries ticked consents for the same bike; this is reported under G-165/G-159.

When moto==null, booking_form_widget.dart:357-364 returns BookingNoMotoV2 before any form state is read. BookingNoMotoV2 (booking_form_view_v2.dart:303-323) is an MgStateScreen with the title 'Nejdřív si vyber motorku', the primary button selectMotoBtn (go /search) and a back action that pops or goes to /search. These are the same targets as the old look (:387-401).

datesKnown is part of the shared canProceedNow (booking_form_widget.dart:541-554), and v2 uses it at :582. v2 gets the same AsyncValue (:562) and the same retry (:595). The v2 date card shows the same MgErrorView while the calendar is open (booking_date_v2.dart:96-104). Whatever the calendar state, BookingWarningsV2 shows a red banner with the heading 'Obsazenost motorky se nepodařilo načíst', the text fxBookedDatesWait and a retry button (booking_warning_v2.dart:76-85; bookedFailed at booking_form_view_v2.dart:269-271), and the dock shows 'Obsazenost se nenačetla' (:169). This is at least as clear as the old look.

The lock is the same datesKnown in canProceedNow (booking_form_widget.dart:546-554, :582). Where the old look was silent, v2 explains it: the dock says 'Ověřujeme obsazenost motorky' (booking_form_view_v2.dart:168), and a loading banner appears above the calendar while it is open (booking_date_v2.dart:106-107).

The old look had no client check; the only guard was the database refusal (trg_check_booking_overlap) at the payment insert, and v2 keeps it through the shared _doPayment/_createDraftBooking (payment_screen.dart:1544). v2 adds a lock on top. rangeBusy (booking_form_widget.dart:565, from bookingDraftRangeBusy in booking_sync_v2.dart:41-72, which skips the customer's own pending unpaid draft of the same bike) makes canProceed false (:582) and forces the calendar open (:586). The calendar then shows a red line 'V tomto rozmezí je obsazený den' (booking_date_v2.dart:78-88), and the dock shows 'V termínu je obsazený den' (booking_form_view_v2.dart:170). When the bookings or reservations are not loaded yet, rangeBusy is false, and the case is left to datesKnown and the server, as before.

The overlap check is shared. overlapValidationProvider (booking_provider.dart:237-256) calls checkOverlap and feeds err (booking_form_widget.dart:411), which v2 gets at :571 and uses in canProceed at :582. v2 shows the red banner with a heading and the same text naming the other booking (booking_warning_v2.dart:53-65), the working fix 'Změnit termín' that opens and scrolls to the calendar (booking_form_view_v2.dart:141-146, :154; errKind dates from booking_sync_v2.dart:80-81), and the dock blocker (:171). The server also refuses it with trg_check_user_booking_overlap. Note: bookingDraftRangeBusy does NOT count the customer's own other bookings; it excludes the own unpaid draft. The chunk's wording about it is inaccurate, but this does not change the verdict.
